IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_AI_setup: The AI tab walks you through it: the helper, Ollama, a model, a test reply, or a cloud AI instead. Open the AI folder takes you to Setup.cmd. Talk key, AI wait, language and voice are set there too. Hover any button for more. Doctor check makes one file for bug reports.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Building: Build tab: plan walls, fences, gates, log walls, sandbags (guard post) and barbed wire without materials. The people who live at your base build them from base storage with real tools; a wall is a frame first. Missing something: they say what. "stop building" / "get building" / "fix the fence".
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Camp_widget: A small panel you can drag anywhere. Right-click it to pick what it shows, its size, how see-through it is, lock it, or hide it while all is well.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Groups_out_there: Real groups with real stashes: they farm, craft, trade, raid, move on, hold outposts at police stations, bridges and the only road into town. Nothing spawns loot.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Hotkeys: Options > Mods > A-Life NPC Overhaul: talk to the nearest person (press again to close the talk window), repeat your last order (to the same people; spots worked out again from where you are), the A-Life window, the radial, hover.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Immersive: On (the default): no numbers. You read people by how they act and by asking them ("do you trust me?"), and they can lie. Off: the bond numbers, the bond notes and the Factions overview come back. Switch it in Settings any time; it's kept with this world.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Letters: News that isn't a decision shows at the right edge, shrinks to a small tab, and stays until you clear it: left-click a tab to read it again, hover to peek, right-click to clear. Right-click "Clear all" to clear all but the red ones, or show only the important (red) ones or only the news. Important news (a death, someone turning on you) pops up in the middle and pauses the game; it leaves a red letter too.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Missed_something_: Letters and notes go by fast. Now tab > Missed something? keeps the last ones, red for the bad ones.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Named_places: Stand somewhere and pick Name this spot: on the quick wheel (point at the ground), on the Camp tab, or right-click the ground. It goes on your map; send people there to meet you or to hold it.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Orders: Follow me, wait here, guard here, go back to the base, meet me at / hold a place you named. The quick-order bar (Now tab) keeps your favourites on screen.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Out_ahead: Take point, scout ahead, keep an eye on him, search that body, lure them off, go tell Sam..., give him some food, fall back to <a place you named>, take me to your leader. Lookouts call out what they see.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_People: Everyone you've met, journal style: only what you've learned. Tick names to give several people one order.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Quick_wheel: Point at someone and open the wheel (your hotkey, D-pad up, the vehicle menu): talk, follow, wait, guard, orders, their page. Point at nothing: your quick orders, name this spot, radio, this window. The full list is under right-click > A-Life, and on these tabs.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Radio: Call one person by name over a walkie: they need a radio of their own (or the base's set), on your channel, in range. Your people check in when you're gone a while and call when the base is hit.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Reading_people: Rest the mouse on someone for half a second: a line over their head says how they are toward you and why (wary, out for you, won't come along and why). Same words on the quick wheel and at the top of the talk window. Settings: off, hold-a-key only, delay, range.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Talking: Type in chat like you'd talk (with or without /say). Start or end with ! to shout. With the AI helper they understand anything and answer in their own voice; without it, plain commands work.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Talking_while_paused: Pause, press the chat key and type. They answer while the game stays paused.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_The_camp_s_notes: Stores getting thin, new faces, losses, groups warming or cooling toward you. Now > The camp's notes.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Trade: Real people bring real goods after the real walk or drive. Set a trading post, pick a market day on the radio. Every item has its own worth.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_When_something_breaks: A feature that hits an error switches itself off and you get a note. Send console.txt (in your Zomboid folder) and Zomboid/Lua/ALifeChatPlus_health.txt. AI trouble: AI tab > Doctor check, then send Zomboid/Lua/alifeai_doctor.txt.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Why_not: When someone refuses, you're told why in plain words, and it goes in their journal.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_World: Your journal of groups and places: what you were told, by whom, when. The war map shows the wars you know of.
IGUI_ALCP_HelpText_Your_camp: Give people jobs (cook, medic, guard, builder, farmer), set rules, patrols and the alarm, fortify, mark work zones. The camp board shows everyone's day.
IGUI_ALCP_JournalNeedPen: You need a pen or pencil to mark your map.

IGUI_ALCP_TipCamp: <SIZE:medium> Camp <LINE> <SIZE:small> The camp board, and every camp menu in one place: roles, rules, patrol, alarm, kitchen, farm and the rest, work zones, and Jeem's base and residents if you use Jeem. <LINE> <LINE> Name a spot ('the north gate') and you can send people there to meet you or to hold it.
IGUI_ALCP_TipNow: <SIZE:medium> Now <LINE> <SIZE:small> What needs you and what changed: decisions waiting for you, who's away, traders at your place, and the camp's own notes. Nothing here is a live readout: it's what you'd know.
IGUI_ALCP_TipPeople: <SIZE:medium> People <LINE> <SIZE:small> Your journal of everyone you've met. Only what you've learned: names they told you, what they said and did, how they seem toward you, when and where you last saw them. <LINE> <LINE> Tick the box at the left of a name to give several people the same order.
IGUI_ALCP_TipRadio: <SIZE:medium> Radio <LINE> <SIZE:small> Who can hear you depends on the radio you have with you or stand next to. Call out to find people, ask friends for traders or help, and (with Jeem) call your own base on the walkie.
IGUI_ALCP_TipTrade: <SIZE:medium> Trade <LINE> <SIZE:small> Your trading post, market days and the traders on their way or at your place. Hold something and ask what it's worth to people out there: every item has its own worth, and groups pay more for what they lack.
IGUI_ALCP_Tip_SandboxBack: Forget every switch you saved here for this world. The world's sandbox options decide again.
